messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated tail latency detected on prod-serving-pool-2. p95: 1.6s, p99: 5.2s over 5m window. Hot routes: /v1/chat-stream, /v1/generate-stream. Auto-posting to #eng-oncall and paging on-call.

lina (on-call): noticed a cluster-wide uptick in streaming stalls. No 5xxs but lots of resumed streams. p99 around 5s, some clients reporting multiple reconnect attempts. Starting triage.

omar (sre): pulling host-level metrics. KV cache eviction rate jumped on shard group B (hosts b4-b10). Disk IO latency on those boxes up ~6x. Prefill write rate spiked concurrently.

rachel (runtime): stack traces show streaming workers blocked on page reads during prefill merge. We have many large context requests writing big KV entries; slab allocator fragmentation causing frequent page-in ops.

lina (on-call): customer impact? sam from support, can you check incoming tickets?

support-bot: cust-alpha submitted a realtime log indicating audio transcription stream stalls. cust-beta reported long pauses but resumed. No formal SEs opened yet.

sam (support): texting both customers with same status. cust-alpha says they saw multiple 4-6s pauses and one client-side reconnect. cust-beta on long-context summarization workloads - sounds like a match.

omar (sre): graph: https://dash.redwood/kv?range=5m&hosts=b4-b10 — eviction/sec up +900, page_faults up to 4200/min. Prefill queue depth rising. Decode throughput trending down on those hosts.

rachel (runtime): mitigation options:
- run slab-rebalance with low concurrency (non-disruptive attempt to reduce fragmentation)
- reduce prefill concurrency for streaming endpoints (simple config toggle)
- temporarily increase decode workers on affected nodes (costly but fast)

lina (on-call): let's do slab-rebalance with conservative defaults and simultaneously flip prefill throttle to 70% for stream endpoints. If p99 doesn't fall in 90s, we scale decode.

omar (sre): executing:
```
ops> ./tools/slab_rebalance --hosts b4-b10 --concurrency 3 --max-moves 500
INFO: scheduled 500 slab moves, concurrency=3
```

rachel (runtime): applying runtime flag:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api/flags -d '{"flag":"prefill_stream_concurrency","value":0.7}'
```

incident-bot: Flag change applied by rachel. slab_rebalance started by omar.

omar (sre): within 60s eviction/sec down to +300, page_faults trending to ~900/min. prefill queue length decreasing. p95 dropped to 1.0s, p99 at 2.4s.

sam (support): cust-alpha reports noticeably better stream stability. cust-beta reporting fewer pauses. Sending update to both.

lina (on-call): still seeing isolated tail on b7. rachel could we firewall a single host to prevent reshuffle operations from thrashing it? Or limit moves per-host.

rachel (runtime): adjusted rebalance to exclude b7 temporarily: `--exclude-hosts b7`. Also bumped decode replica count on pool-b decode service by +2 to help drain backlog.

omar (sre): decode pods scaled up: `kubectl scale deployment/decode-b-pool --replicas=10 -n serving`. New pods passing readiness.

rachel (runtime): observed backlog draining, prefill-to-decode ratio normalizing. Root cause candidate: recent prefill aggressiveness change in rollout 2026-02-15 increased prefill write size for long contexts which interacted poorly with slab allocator binning rules.

lina (on-call): can we revert that heuristic for now and prepare a safer rollout? Also add a short-runbook step for limiting slab_rebalance concurrency.

rachel (runtime): reverting flag: `--prefill-aggressive=false` and opening PR with telemetry gating + gradual ramp. PR link: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/482

omar (sre): post-rollback numbers: p95 0.8s, p99 1.5s, eviction/sec ~120, page_faults ~220/min. Streaming errors back to baseline for ~99% of sessions.

sam (support): both customers confirm streams stable; cust-alpha closing incident ticket.

lina (on-call): summary and action items:
- RCA: KV cache slab fragmentation compounded by a recent aggressive prefill heuristic. Large long-context entries produced uneven slab utilization -> increased page faults/evictions -> tail latency and streaming stalls.
- Mitigations: conservative slab_rebalance (re-run with limits), prefill concurrency throttle, scale decode workers on affected pool, rollback prefill heuristic.
- Follow-ups: runtime to produce safer A/B rollout + telemetry gates (rachel), SRE to add slab_rebalance guidance to runbook and an alert for slab-fragmentation signals (omar), support to follow up with affected customers and close tickets (sam).

rachel (runtime): opening follow-up tasks and will include a small test harness to simulate long-context slab behavior. PR and test plan linked in thread.

omar (sre): I'll add Grafana panels for slab fragmentation ratio and an alert when page_faults > 1k/min combined with eviction/sec > 400.

lina (on-call): handing off to night oncall @niko in 25m. Pinging with short handoff note.

niko (on-call): ack. I'll monitor page_faults and p99 overnight and escalate if regression.

incident-bot: [RESOLVED] Tail latency incident mitigated. p99 returned below SLO. Tags: kv-cache, slab-rebalance, prefill-throttle, streaming-stalls.

lina (on-call): closing thread. Drafting postmortem with timeline and proposed permanent fix options. Will link ops commands used and graphs in postmortem."
